purpose: Document first-party local registry evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-service review for Baidoa.
assessment: Baidoa Municipality publicly identifies a Public Works, Housing, and Land Administration Department and a Land Registration service. The official FAO SWALIM Geoportal and its anonymous GeoServer WFS were inspected as a related Somali geospatial source. The WFS exposed building and settlement/environmental data, but no parcel/cadastral feature type. A bounded exact-point-area request returned buildings only; no parcel geometry was retained.
registryAssessment: Local municipal land-registration custody is evidenced by the official Baidoa Municipality site. No open digital parcel registry or public cadastral geometry endpoint was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official municipality page lists the Public Works, Housing, and Land Administration Department and Land Registration service.
Official local department page was reachable anonymously; no parcel download or public map/API was exposed in the response.
Official FAO SWALIM Geoportal describes open Somalia spatial datasets, including land and settlements, but not a cadastral registry.

uncertainty: The municipality may maintain offline, authenticated, or request-only parcel records. A missing public layer, zero exact-point parcel hit, or building-only response is not evidence of citywide absence.
